# Independent visual QA — issue #71

**Issue:** [Reset a password with purpose-bound proof and recover the correct session](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/71). **Reviewer:** GPT-6.1 Sol, High reasoning. **Date:** 2026-10-25 (Asia/Qyzylorda). Review only; no acceptance, reopening, product/spec changes, Git/GitHub mutations or production claims.

**Verdict:** The principal mock UI journey works, including retained invalid-code correction, matching-password validation and the New dub destination. It still has two meaningful implementation omissions, a small reference mismatch, and two usability concerns. Findings: **0 HIGH / 3 MEDIUM / 2 LOW**. The task should not be described as visually complete without resolving or explicitly accepting these findings.

## Snapshot, method and boundaries

HEAD `9d286621177200fdb5f61ef963d0b6818ae76774`; `git status --porcelain -- frontend` was empty. Existing dirty documentation, skills and evidence were preserved. This reviewer wrote only this `issue-71` directory. [Snapshot](snapshot.json) records the boundary. The live issue snapshot in `../contracts/issue-71.md` is dated 2026-10-25, closed, with zero discussion comments. The current local Flow 04, token/adoption/catalog/workflow documents were reviewed as the applicable contract; old accepted reports were not reused as fresh proof.

Purpose/user job: recover access to an email/password account, prove the reset request, enter and confirm a replacement password, then return signed in to an authorized destination with other sessions ended. The public request response must remain neutral even when the email cannot reset an account.

Fresh Chromium screenshots came from installed Playwright, isolated contexts, Vite mock mode on unique port **4371**, with muted audio and fake-media flags. No physical devices or real email were used. Actual app journeys used `/reset-password`; their prerequisite synthetic verified email/password identities were created through the centralized `createServices().registration.start/verify` facade and then signed out. This setup is explicit in [capture.cjs](capture.cjs) and [capture-log.json](capture-log.json): it is not registration UI or real ownership proof. Request, wrong-code correction, correct code, mismatch and success navigation then used the actual visible mock UI.

Three states used the repository's existing controlled visual harness, not naturally occurring failures: `reset-service-error`, `reset-unknown-code`, `reset-complete-loading` (held and then released to `adapter-unavailable`). The last confirms entered values survive the controlled service failure, not real network reliability. A supplementary real mock expiry check advanced the browser/service clock by 11 minutes; it did not replace service responses.

Commands: `node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --mode mock --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4371 --strictPort` from `frontend`; `node .../issue-71/capture.cjs`; `node .../issue-71/supplement.cjs`. Both capture scripts exited 0. There were no recorded page errors in the primary journeys. All **26 fresh screenshots** were individually opened with `view_image` and inspected. [Manifest](screenshot-manifest.json) includes hashes and inspection flags; [metrics](metrics.json) contain viewport/page widths, focus, actual control dimensions and fonts after `document.fonts.ready`.

## Expected versus observed

| Criterion/state | Expected | Fresh observation / evidence | Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|
| AC-01 request/neutral/error | Email validation; neutral response; safe transport correction | Existing synthetic identity and nonexistent identity reach neutral code entry. Empty email focuses the field; controlled request error preserves email above action. `request-en-desktop`, `email-error-*`, `reload-code-en-short`, `request-service-error-en-short` | Confirmed visible subset; all six identity classes not retested |
| AC-02 six-cell code | Single named input, complete-value verification, rejected digits retained/selected | Wrong `000000` remains red with error below; logical selection `[0,6]`; replacing it with the local mock code opens password entry without Confirm. `invalid-code-en-desktop`, `invalid-code-ru-phone` | Confirmed exercised path; full autofill/duplicate matrix not run |
| AC-03 recovery/timing | Restore selected email/code state; no inferred success; service expiry | Reload restores email/code entry. 11-minute clock advance shows expired recovery and another-email action. `reload-code-en-short`, `expired-ru-short` | Visible restoration/expiry confirmed; no fresh call-count proof of no auto-send |
| AC-04 password/errors | Two required matching values, minimum 8, visibility controls, retained service failure | Eight lowercase characters succeed; mismatch appears under Repeat and receives focus; controlled failure preserves both 8-character values. **Visibility controls absent**. `password-*`, `mismatch-*`, `password-service-error-en-phone` | Partial, QA-71-01 |
| AC-05 completion/destination | Authoritative result, signed-in destination and clear completion/session confirmation | Actual mock navigates to `/new`, signed-in header visible. **No completion or other-session statement appears at destination**. `success-destination-*` | Destination confirmed; feedback omission QA-71-02; revocation truth not inferred from UI |
| AC-06 purpose binding/link isolation | Reset cannot use registration/link proof | Relevant service guards exist; no fresh adversarial cross-purpose browser matrix | Evidence gap; no security acceptance |
| AC-07 EN/RU, focus/privacy | Localized forms, accessible values, responsive UI | EN/RU forms and error copy render; invalid fields focus; Mabry 400/500 loaded; no horizontal page overflow in captured states. Automatic next-step transitions leave BODY focused. | Exercised subset only; no screen-reader/privacy audit |
| AC-08 uncertain/failure outcomes | Reconcile unknown; avoid premature success | Controlled unknown verification shows Check reset status, no password form/success; held completion shows Saving password. `unknown-verification-ru-phone`, `password-loading-en-short` | Controlled representation confirmed, not real adapter proof |
| AC-VIS-01 | Clean/Light geometry, typography, states | Primary dark/secondary white, radius6 actions, field derivatives, source-related OTP cells and strong focus. Desktop primary28px/13px; phone primary48px/16px. **OTP digits24/32 desktop and22/32 phone instead of15/24**. | Partial, QA-71-03/04 |

Coverage includes EN desktop1440×900, EN short1440×700, RU desktop1440×900, RU short1440×700, EN/RU390×844, and EN767/768×844 code states. It is intentionally not the full locale × viewport × state Cartesian product. Ordinary vertical scrolling occurs in the long code/error state; it is not labeled overflow failure. No horizontal overflow was measured.

## Findings

### QA-71-01 — MEDIUM — Both required password visibility controls are missing

**Class/status:** confirmed implementation defect. **Affected:** AC-04/07, Flow04 §4.5 and §7. Reproduce: request a reset for the synthetic verified account, enter the displayed mock code, inspect both new-password fields, enter mismatching values. Expected separate show/hide controls with persistent accessible names and exposed state; actual fields remain `type=password` with no control to inspect either value.

[Flow04:143](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/frontend-flows/04-password-reset.md:143) explicitly requires the controls. [PasswordResetScreen.tsx:712](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/auth/PasswordResetScreen.tsx:712) and line730 render plain password TextFields without visibility actions. This is especially costly during a mismatch: the user can only retype masked text and may repeat the error. Restore localized, independently operated controls with proper state/name, preserve values and focus, and retain phone targets. Next validation: keyboard and phone toggle each field independently, mismatch recovery, paste/password-manager behavior.

![RU phone password form has no visibility controls](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-71/evidence/password-ru-phone.png)

### QA-71-02 — MEDIUM — Successful reset navigates away without the required completion/session confirmation

**Class/status:** confirmed implementation defect in feedback; no claim that session revocation itself failed. **Affected:** AC-05/07, Flow04 §4.6. Reproduce: complete the actual mock reset with matching eight-character passwords. Expected an unambiguous password-change statement and confirmation of the current-device sign-in/other-session termination after authoritative completion. Actual `/new` shows only the ordinary New dub page and authenticated navigation.

[Flow04:155](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/frontend-flows/04-password-reset.md:155) requires the statement. [PasswordResetScreen.tsx:255](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/auth/PasswordResetScreen.tsx:255) navigates before setting completed/changed state; that local screen then unmounts. The destination screenshots show no reset acknowledgement. The user receives no explanation that the password changed or that other devices were signed out. Carry a localized, accessible completion notice to the destination after the confirmed result, preserving immediate authorized navigation and avoiding claims about unconfirmed effects. Next validation: observe destination notice in EN/RU, verify it is announced once, and ensure partial/unknown outcomes never show it.

![Actual mock success destination without reset acknowledgement](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-71/evidence/success-destination-en-desktop.png)

### QA-71-03 — MEDIUM — Compact desktop primary actions are undersized for this sparse recovery flow

**Class/status:** requirement/design flaw; implementation follows the selected compact desktop token. **Affected:** AC-VIS-01 and Flow04 desktop interaction. Reproduce at1440×900 or1440×700: inspect Send reset email/Save new password. Measured primary **350×28px**, label **13px/20px**, adjacent input40px and body16px. In the sparse form the primary label looks noticeably smaller than its surrounding instructions, and the shallow target requires more vertical pointing precision than the adjacent field. This is a usability judgement, **not a claimed WCAG violation**.

[design-tokens.md:88](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/frontend-flows/design-tokens.md:88) and the selected source permit24/28/32px desktop actions; [button.tsx:24](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/components/ui/button.tsx:24) selects medium by default. Review the auth action role specifically: propose the existing32px large variant or a documented larger auth-only target/label adaptation while preserving Mabry, monochrome treatment and source state recipes. Do not globally enlarge dense application rows. Next validation: compare rendered28/32px (and, if authorized,40px) auth variants at normal desktop scale with pointer and keyboard users. Phone48px actions already look proportionate and should remain.

![Desktop primary action relative to its input and instructions](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-71/evidence/request-en-desktop.png)

### QA-71-04 — LOW — OTP displayed typography departs from the explicit source mapping

**Class/status:** confirmed implementation/reference mismatch. **Affected:** AC-VIS-01. Reproduce a rejected code at desktop and phone. Expected the token's Medium15px/24px digits and40×44px preferred cells; actual desktop cells match40×44 but digits are **24px/32px**; phone uses36×44 and **22px/32px** despite40px cells fitting within its292px content width. The six-cell field remains readable and has a48px logical target; this is not an accessibility failure.

[OtpInput.css:45](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/auth/OtpInput.css:45) hardcodes24px/32px and the max420 rule changes only font size to22px. [design-tokens.md:108](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/frontend-flows/design-tokens.md:108) and raw Clean OTP lines646–663 map15px/24px. Larger digits change the reference's quiet proportions; if their increased legibility is desired, document and approve that adaptation instead of claiming exact fidelity. Next validation: component crop against the Light invalid-code PNG at CSS-pixel size with Mabry retained; check36px shrinking only where needed.

![Retained invalid code with oversized displayed digits](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-71/evidence/invalid-code-en-desktop.png)

### QA-71-05 — LOW — Code instructions repeat verbatim and push recovery actions downward

**Class/status:** confirmed composition defect / optional content improvement. **Affected:** AC-VIS-01, Flow04 code-entry hierarchy. Reproduce a successful reset request: the exact same “Enter the six-digit reset code for [email]” instruction appears immediately under the heading and again after the neutral notice. It consumes another40px on the observed RU phone and adds repetition to an already long state. The invalid RU code state reaches871px content height in an844px viewport; this is ordinary scrolling, but avoidable duplication increases it.

[PasswordResetScreen.tsx:643](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/auth/PasswordResetScreen.tsx:643) passes the instruction to AuthLayout; [line685](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/auth/PasswordResetScreen.tsx:685) repeats it in the body. Retain one instruction and the mandatory neutral privacy statement. Keep the explicit local-mock delivery disclaimer in this mock environment. Next validation: recheck RU phone/error/short-height code screen and email readability without duplicate copy; do not infer physical keyboard coverage from a desktop emulator.

![RU code screen repeats its instruction above and below neutral notice](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-71/evidence/code-ru-phone.png)

## Reference comparison and positive results

Inspected the pinned raw Clean BTN Markdown (Light tokens/geometry289–376) with `source/components/button/Clean/Light/01-initial.png`, and raw OTP Markdown (tokens/cells596–665) with `source/components/otp-input/Clean/Light/03-invalid-code.png`, under `_docs/evidence/affect-ui-clean-light`. Matching source references are preserved in the shared manifest; no Dark/Classic examples or example security policies were adopted.

Dark primary, white secondary,6px action radius,40×44/radius8 desktop OTP cells, red tinted invalid state, and the shared48px logical input preserve recognizable selected treatment. Explicit contrast adaptations use stronger control boundaries/red ink/opaque blue focus, rather than copying faint decorative source strokes. The actual Mabry400/500 faces reported loaded after fonts settled. Primary phone fields/actions were48px and16px/24px; localized long labels fitted. The input label remained16px even with visually overlaid cells. The rejected logical value was selected `[0,6]`, and field-specific failures moved focus to the relevant field while retaining values. Unknown state did not mislabel code as invalid or navigate to success. Source typography, motion and policy should remain distinct: no motion timing/fidelity acceptance is claimed here.

RU phone reset correctly rendered RU before success; the seeded account had default EN preference, and browser-derived RU was not a manual override, so its post-success EN destination is **not reported as a locale defect**. Manual-language precedence was not independently exercised.

## Remaining evidence gaps and next checks

This bounded review does not establish all six identity classes, exact send-cap boundaries, resend replacement, cross-purpose/replay/identity attacks, all unknown/partial session outcomes, persisted-project return or manual-link recovery. Read-only service guards and old tests are leads, not fresh security verification. No real mail, provider, password security,30-day real session or other-device revocation was tested. No full suite was run.

Native200% browser zoom, real software-keyboard occlusion, screen-reader announcement quality, forced colors, reduced-motion timing, long-address stress, Safari/Firefox and physical phones remain untested. BODY focus after successful phase transitions is recorded in metrics; it merits a focused keyboard/screen-reader follow-up, but this report does not infer an accessibility violation from focus position alone. Coverage is targeted, not universal product acceptance.
